extension.description: Reviews drip runs that change local setup (install), write the token ledger (sync) or launch another command (run), and keeps the read-only views (statusline, session, history, explain, open, splash, watch) unreviewed.
extension.name: drip command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `drip install`, which imports Claude Code and Codex history into the local ledger (~/.local/share/drip/usage.db), symlinks bin/drip into ~/.local/bin, and adds a statusLine command to ~/.claude/settings.json when none is set, so Claude Code runs drip on every status-line refresh. Without a TTY (for example from an agent) it also opens a new terminal window to play its intro. It has no preview form.
permissions.label: drip setup
safer_guidance: Run `drip explain` or bare `drip` to see the estimates without changing any settings.
Check the statusLine entry in ~/.claude/settings.json first; install leaves an existing custom status line in place and prints the line to add instead.

permissions.description: Identifies `drip sync`, which reads every Claude Code transcript under ~/.claude/projects and Codex rollout under ~/.codex/sessions and writes new token counts and file offsets into the local ledger (~/.local/share/drip/usage.db). It has no preview form.
permissions.label: drip ledger import
safer_guidance: Run `drip history` or `drip session` to read the current totals; they refresh the ledger only for display.

permissions.description: Identifies `drip run <command>`, which resolves the given command on PATH or a known install location and replaces itself with it, after opening a meter pane through tmux, Ghostty or iTerm2 AppleScript, a Warp tab config (written to ~/.warp/tab_configs), or a separate Terminal window. Any command can follow `run`, so it is reviewed as execution.
permissions.label: drip agent launch
safer_guidance: Start the agent directly and run `drip watch` in a pane you split yourself.
